note: missing required deliverable (evidence-submission-opinion.md) -> score 0; each extra file directly under the delivery root -> one DX_DELIVERABLE instance (0.4, cap 2). Subdirectories are never extras. The harness manifest.json is allow-listed because the harness writes it into every delivery.

source_dump.note: a run of >= 700 normalized characters copied verbatim from a materials file is one DX_SOURCE_DUMP instance (0.4, cap 2). Golden's own longest verbatim run is 421, so ordinary quotation stays free.

language.brief: Write it in Chinese and save it as `artifacts/evidence-submission-opinion.
language.note: Measured as the share of script-bearing characters (Han vs Latin letters). Golden evidence-submission-opinion.md measures 0.973; an opinion written in the opposite script measures far below 0.5, so the threshold separates the two cleanly.
